text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. Can you tell me how old the child is and how long these bleeding symptoms have been present?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-year-old male. The child's parent reports that the child has been experiencing frequent episodes of nosebleeds and has had several instances of bleeding from the gums. Additionally, there have been occurrences of unexplained bruising and petechiae, primarily on the distal extremities.

speaker: Doctor
text: Does the child have a history of joint bleeds or hemarthrosis, and have you noticed any bleeding after minor injuries or dental procedures? I also need to know if there is a family history of bleeding disorders or if the child has had frequent infections recently.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Frequent epistaxis. I also have Mucous membrane bleeding, Diffuse petechiae on distal extremities.

speaker: Doctor
text: I need to clarify if the child has had any recent viral illnesses or fever, and whether there is any family history of bleeding disorders. Additionally, has the child experienced any bleeding from the gastrointestinal tract or in the urine?

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: No significant past medical issues. Up-to-date on vaccinations. Social history: Attends preschool. Lives with parents and one older sibling.

speaker: Doctor
text: Have there been any recent viral illnesses or fevers preceding these symptoms, and has the child had any bleeding from the gastrointestinal tract or in the urine? REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the normal platelet count, we need to evaluate coagulation factors to rule out von Willebrand disease or hemophilia. REQUEST TEST: Bleeding_Time, Prothrombin_Time, Partial_Thromboplastin_Time

speaker: Doctor
text: I need to see the results of the Bleeding Time test you ordered, as a prolonged bleeding time with normal coagulation studies strongly suggests a platelet function disorder or von Willebrand disease. REQUEST TEST: Bleeding_Time

speaker: Doctor
text: Since bleeding time, PT, PTT, and platelet count are all normal, I need to specifically evaluate for von Willebrand disease. REQUEST TEST: Von_Willebrand_Factor_Antigen, Von_Willebrand_Factor_Activity

speaker: Doctor
text: With normal platelet count, coagulation studies, and von Willebrand factors, I need to rule out platelet function defects. REQUEST TEST: Platelet_Function_Assay

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Platelet surfaces deficient in GIIb/IIIa receptors.
